subject: Follow-up from Inference Summit — potential Redwood pilot and next steps
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Zhang <olivia@lumosanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-04-12T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Great meeting at Inference Summit — quick recap + next steps

Hi Olivia,

Really enjoyed our conversation at the Inference Summit today — appreciate you carving out time between sessions. Quick recap from my side:
- You mentioned Lumos runs real-time reranking and personalized summaries for enterprise accounts, with tight 150ms P95 latency targets for short prompts.
- Main pain: inconsistent tail latency with current infra when traffic spikes, and rising per-token cost for peak loads.
- Success criteria you highlighted: predictable latency at scale, predictable unit economics, and a path to pilot without heavy infra lift.

Next steps I suggested:
1) 20–30 min technical sync with your infra lead to run a quick latency/cost profile and map a pilot scope (samples + metrics).
2) A short mutual action plan so procurement knows timelines and security deliverables.

Are you available this week or early next for the tech sync? If easier, loop in the right folks and I’ll coordinate. I attached a one-pager with our deployment modes for context.

Thanks again — look forward to continuing the conversation.

Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

Attachment: redwood-one-pager.pdf
